translation: This is to draw the blood vessels of the five viscera (五臟) so that they become harmonious. Wait until the person groans audibly in the mouth, then mix Bālí Powder (八釐散) with boy's urine (童便) and take it warm, whereby the qi may turn and the yang return. Externally, use the hands to press and push the chest, the two flanks, the armpits, and the upper abdomen, and gently support the inner wrist and gather the sinews, rubbing and kneading frequently; this is the high bone behind the palm, the place where the cun, guan, and chi (寸關尺) pulse is taken. When one is struck and injured, the sinews and vessels become stiff; with frequent rubbing and kneading, the heart blood returns, the vital pulse flows freely, and one may be brought back to life.
